sources.title: Invoice processing prebuilt AI model | Microsoft Learn
sources.snippet: The invoice processing prebuilt AI model extracts key invoice data to help automate the processing of invoices. The invoice processing model is optimized to recognize common invoice elements like invoice ID, invoice date, amount due, and more. The Invoices model allows you to augment the default behavior by building a custom Invoices model.

sources.snippet: AI MyInvois Mapper An AI-assisted tool for Malaysian SMEs to map sales documents (spreadsheets, receipts, scanned invoices) into LHDN MyInvois e-Invoice submissions: upload a file, review the AI-mapped fields, confirm, and submit via the MyInvois API.
